svg.title: A scalar multiple has norm at most |a|√QvD2n; triangle inequality extends (ST1) to every finite word combination. Hence a diagonal estimate on individual words really does produce a bounded operator on their entire dense span. This bounds the entire dense span without presupposing boundedness, in every character. The lift retains the algebraic insertion maps and Gram adjoint relation. Isometric recovery preserves powers and null spaces, transporting (ST1)–(ST3) and the bounded extension with the same norm.
